_comment: Deterministic binding KAT for pqsig.DeriveFromEd25519Seed (research.md R4). The Ed25519 seed below is a fixed, non-secret test value. Re-running DeriveFromEd25519Seed on this seed MUST produce an ML-DSA-65 public/private keypair whose canonical packed bytes hash to the SHA-256 values recorded here. If any of these values change after a CIRCL upgrade, the upgrade is wire-incompatible and must be treated as a hybrid-identity break across the deployment.
